report.summary: Chunk 8 of typegraph.py: defines pass 2 annotation resolution, emit/record helpers, and site iteration for declarations and fields.
risks: unresolved_sample | medium | Collects unresolved annotations but no upper bound; could grow unbounded in large repos | Add a limit or sampling strategy
ambiguous_sample | medium | Similar unbounded collection for ambiguous annotations | Add a limit or sampling strategy
edges dict | low | edges dict is built but not persisted or returned in this chunk; caller must handle it | Verify caller consumes edges

handoff.purpose: Second pass: resolve annotations and emit edges for inherits, alias_of, and has_field relations.

symbols.name: record
symbols.note: Closure updating counters and appending to unresolved_sample or ambiguous_sample based on outcome kind.

symbols.name: emit
symbols.note: Closure that normalizes a site's annotation, updates site_counts, and calls resolver.resolve for each member, appending edges on RESOLVED.

symbols.name: resolver
symbols.note: Instance of _Resolver initialized with tbf, facts_by_rel, imports_by_file, naming.

symbols.name: counters
symbols.note: Dict tracking counts for each outcome kind from _OUTCOMES.

symbols.name: site_counts
symbols.note: Dict tracking various annotation site statistics.

symbols.name: cov
symbols.note: Dict tracking coverage counts for params, returns, fields, bases, functions.

symbols.name: unresolved_sample
symbols.note: List of tuples recording unresolved annotation samples.

symbols.name: ambiguous_sample
symbols.note: List of tuples recording ambiguous annotation samples.

symbols.name: edges
symbols.note: Dict mapping relation names to lists of edge dicts.

claims.text: class C(Base, metaclass=M) -- parse.py keeps keyword arguments in bases as written. A metaclass is not a base and must not become an inherits edge.
claims.why: The code checks if '=' appears in base before splitting on '[' and continues (skips) if true, preventing metaclass from becoming an inherits edge.

observations.what: record function is defined but also used inside emit; both are closures capturing counters and sample lists.
emit function calls resolver.resolve but resolver is defined outside the closure; it's captured from the enclosing scope.
edges dict is populated with has_field edges but the code for inherits and alias_of only calls emit which also appends to edges; has_field edges are appended directly.
cov counters for bases are incremented but not used for edges; bases are processed via emit which also updates site_counts.
